name: nh3h2o_absorption_rectifier_heat
title: Single-stage ammonia-water absorption cycle with rectifier heat recovery
summary: Single-stage NH3H2O absorption refrigeration cycle, Herold, Radermacher and Klein Example 9.5: the cycle of Example 9.3 (condensate precooler, CSL-0360) with all the rectifier heat recovered into the rich solution instead of rejected - the solution stream 2 is heated to 16 by the rectifier duty and enters the solution heat exchanger at 16. Given the heat rejection temperatures (40 C), the evaporator temperature (-10 C) and the design goals (x[9] = 0.99, DELTAx = 0.1), the model computes the state points, the component heat rates and the COP.
language_features: NH3H2O fluid (any three of T, P, X, Q, H, S, U, V)
PROCEDURE shx (kept; Min() = smaller of two capacity rates)

origin.notes: Example 9.5 of Herold, Radermacher and Klein, Absorption Chillers and Heat Pumps, CRC Press, 2nd ed., 2015; EES example of F-Chart Software, distributed by the EES-Community/ees-examples repository (commit 5c703d0, folder Case_Study/). The .eez companion stores the binary .EES with the solution used as verification reference. Credit: (c) F-Chart Software / S. A. Klein, MIT via EES-Community/ees-examples.

verification.summary: The native file was solved in CoolSolve and compared with the EES stored solution (compare_solution.py --ees-units, 126 common variables): COP within 1.3 %, heat rates within 1.8 %, pressures within 2.2 %, temperatures within 2.4 %. Whole-cycle balance closes to -6.3e-06 W on 499 kW. Mass fractions differ by up to 3.4e-02, explained by the NH3H2O property backend (P_low at identical inputs differs 2.13e-02).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of the binary Ex9_5.EES inside ex9_5.eez (ees_variables.csv), compared with tools/compare_solution.py --ees-units
verification.notes: Compared set: 126 common variables. Excluded: h[i], s[i], swp (absolute NH3H2O enthalpy/entropy, different reference state in EES and CoolProp; the EES v[2..14], Q[2], Q[3], Q[5], Q[11], Q[14] records are stale, the file computes none of them), checkQ (balance residual: EES -3.4e-07 J, CoolSolve -6.3e-06 W on 499 kW), cp_1011/cp_1314/cp_163 (reference units J/g-K not converted by --ees-units, CS-BUG-COMPARE-JGK; true diffs 3.8e-03, 5.1e-03 and 3.4e-02). Max kept rel diff as printed: Q[6] 5.11e-02 (two-phase quality inheriting the composition shift); x[4] 3.34e-02; DELTAt_glide 2.64e-02 (17.72 K vs 17.25 K); P_low 2.13e-02; COP_1 1.23e-02.
